name: party-games
description: One launcher app for multiple party games.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/hub && npm install --prefix apps/imposter && npm install --prefix apps/quiz-shooter && npm install --prefix apps/build-a-beast && npm install --prefix apps/planner-habit && npm install --prefix apps/planner-todo && npm install --prefix apps/planner-timer && npm install --prefix apps/planner-assignments
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/hub && node scripts/verify-known-defects.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
